blocks.text: The AWS S3 outegration is used to send data from Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) applications (e.g., Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM)) to your AWS S3 bucket.
This article is a step-by-step guide to setting up the AWS S3 outegration.
Each AWS S3 bucket requires a separate outegration configuration.
